rapport_notes: Excellent — warm, attentive, and genuinely responsive to the customer's own move history and requests.

evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer raised a concern about a fragile vintage record-player credenza ('I want to make sure it doesn't get damaged') outside the formal agenda question; rep acknowledged it ('Credenza, okay') but didn't dig further with a follow-up in the moment
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: 'a few days prior to your move we'll send you the names of the movers, and the day before we'll send you a courtesy text, and on the day itself we'll send an estimated time of arrival' (full Communication coverage) + 'last time we ended up 6 hours and 45 minutes' (window, using the customer's own move history) + 'you only need to pay for the actual hours anyway' (beats-it)

top_strength: Live-adjusted the crew size and estimate on the spot when the customer requested a third mover/trainee based on a great past experience — genuine responsiveness.
coaching_note: The customer flagged a fragile heirloom item as a real concern; a quick 'tell me more about that piece' would have shown it was heard, not just logged.
